statusHistory.note: WILD0's first byline and the first wellness-fitness place in London. Chosen after rejecting Bartitsu: BACKLOG names it as a wanted London topic, but the only London listing on bartitsu.club is a Battersea study group with no address or schedule, on a page marked unfinished — an article topic, not a visitable pin, so no place was created. Brockwell Lido verifies properly and is genuinely current: Fusion Lifestyle entered administration 2026-04-01 and Lambeth took over management on 2026-07-01, with swimmers holding public meetings about the future. Hero is CC BY 2.0 from Commons; attribution required and the record names only an uploader, recorded honestly in licenseNote.
